title: About Me.
bioParagraph1: I'm deeply passionate about cybersecurity — from understanding how systems get compromised to building defenses that keep digital infrastructure safe. My journey started with curiosity about how networks work, and it quickly evolved into a focused pursuit of ethical hacking and security analysis.
bioParagraph2: Whether it's performing network reconnaissance with Nmap, analyzing packets with Wireshark, finding web application vulnerabilities, or scripting automation tools in Python, I'm constantly sharpening my skills through hands-on labs and real-world projects.
